description: Bitcoin: Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates. Every field is computed from the chain alone, so the answer changes only with a new block: elapsed time is measured to the tip block, and `estimatedRetargetDate` is the tip block's time plus `remainingTime`, where mempool.space counts both from its clock. That date is early by the tip's age and, with a block or two left in the epoch, can be before now; add `remainingTime` to your own clock for a date counted from now.
name: get_difficulty_adjustment
title: Difficulty adjustment
